title: Grow the reconciler lifecycle model: the resolve ladder, role jobs, real adoption
body:
The lifecycle model this tick added (internal/reconcile/lifecycle_pbt_test.go) earns its gate seconds today by covering the width arithmetic, the hold vocabulary, the gate-evidence freshness (A13) and the absorption bound over arbitrary sequences. Three things it cannot yet see, each of which is where a real sequence bug would show up first: (1) the resolve ladder — a merge conflict is terminal in the model, while the real run dispatches resolve-conflict jobs and repairs failed gates (gate_repair.go, resolve.go), so the conflict/repair interleavings are uncovered; (2) the review and close-out role jobs — isRoleJob is read by mayAdmit but never dispatched, so the runs-alone rule is untested in the sequence space; (3) adoption from the store's real attempt records rather than the model's durable map. A tick that grows any one of these over the existing fake runner (one repository per case for the cases that need it, shorttest-skipped in the gate, paid by CI) is the cheapest next increment of the #50/#53/o82 class of coverage.
evidence: internal/reconcile/lifecycle_pbt_test.go (the model and its header saying what is model code); internal/reconcile/resolve_conflict_test.go and gate_repair.go for the ladder it does not model
